section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Engaged Living Scale (ELS), a 16-item measure that assesses valued living (values and committed actions) and life fulfillment, based on the ACT model. Items are scored on a 5-point Likert scale, with higher scores indicating greater engagement in meaningful activities. The scale demonstrated high internal consistency in this study with a Cronbach's alpha of .95.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section text describes the Engaged Living Scale, its components, scoring, and reliability.
